emails.body_text:
Hey Richard,

I was checking out drs-roofing.com — 30 years serving Orlando and Central Florida speaks for itself.

One big mobile leak caught my eye: when homeowners tap 'Get A FREE Estimate', they land on a heavy 14-field static form (and 15 fields on Contact) with zero rough Florida-code price range shown first.

So I built a working 30-second Orlando Roof Estimator in your crimson-and-gold DRS Roofing branding. Homeowners tap their roof specs and see an instant hurricane-code ballpark before leaving their name and number.

Mind if I send over the live preview link?

— {{sender_name}}

{{sender_address}} | {{unsubscribe_line}}

objection_handlers.objection: Florida hurricane code, secondary water barriers, and tile underlayment make online quotes tricky.
objection_handlers.reframe_response: 100% agree — this never issues a binding contract price. It gives a realistic Central Florida hurricane-code range with a clear on-site inspection disclaimer so $7,000 tire-kickers filter themselves out while qualified Orlando homeowners arrive pre-educated on licensed pricing ($15k–$45k+).

objection_handlers.objection: Our 14-field form helps filter out unqualified leads.
objection_handlers.reframe_response: Long forms filter out good mobile homeowners just as fast as bad ones because nobody wants to type 14 fields blind on an iPhone. Showing an honest Florida-code price range first is a much stronger filter — tire-kickers leave on their own, while serious buyers gladly drop their name and number.

objection_handlers.objection: Why pay $750 setup + $149/mo when our website already works?
objection_handlers.reframe_response: Your site already draws Central Florida traffic — this just monetizes the mobile visitors leaving your 14-field form without submitting. It routes full roof specs and storm urgency straight to your inbox/CRM, updates quarterly for Florida material costs, and one extra closed roof covers 3+ years.

objection_handlers.objection: Our site is big and I don't want anything breaking WordPress or slowing it down.
objection_handlers.reframe_response: Zero risk to your layout or speed. It's a self-contained 28 KB vanilla JS script inside Shadow DOM isolation so it can never conflict with your theme — and we'll happily pass along the image lazy-load fix for those 176 homepage images free.

objection_handlers.objection: Send me the details and I'll talk it over with the office.
